verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation about Vercel functions using standard Web/runtime APIs (e.g., fetch, Request/Response) for cross-platform portability, nor any claim of avoiding proprietary storage/runtime lock-in. Community commentary instead suggests the opposite — that Vercel usage is tied to being 'locked into the NextJs ecosystem' and limited to 'JS/TS/Go' on top of AWS — indicating no delivered portability story.
